comment: restore.c dorecover(): the current symbol set is not saved, so a game restored on the Rogue level calls assign_graphics(ROGUESET) before docrt(). A debug Archeologist with symset:DECgraphics level-teleports to the Rogue level with the wizard-mode menu and saves; the second segment restores the game, whose first screen draws the Rogue level's plain ASCII walls, and searches once. Seeds and dates were chosen independently of every recorded session.
